name: Kitchel Family Organics
description: In Fort Bidwell, CA, Kitchel Family Organics grows Squash, Corn, Tomatoes, Peppers, and Eggplant on a working farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Nov in this growing zone.
